#: Wording of the checks in test_transport_offline.py. Keys are short Latin labels and never change - translate the right-hand sides only. Placeholders like %(mod)s are filled in by the check: keep them spelled exactly. A key starting with # is a note for translators and is ignored.
transport.404ListsBothTables: the 404 lists reads and writes separately
transport.badRequestCarriesI18n: the 400 carries i18n text, not a traceback
transport.emptyBodyOk: an empty body is an ordinary call
transport.freedPortBindableAgain: the freed port can be bound again
transport.portSilentAfterStop: after shutdown the port does not answer
transport.portSilentAfterStopFail: after shutdown the port does not answer
transport.postBadRequestToo: on POST a request mistake is a 400 as well
transport.readSentAsPost404: a read sent as a POST - 404 with the list
transport.routeNotReachedWithoutToken: without a token the route is never reached
transport.secondIsNextFree: the second port is the next free one
transport.secondOnOtherPort: the second bridge bound another port
transport.serveReturnsPair: serve returned a pair, not just a server
transport.title: the transport, without MO2
